title: System service 'antaiuiserver' exposes transaction 14 (sendMyATCmd) & 4, allowing ANY app on device to send arbitrary…
description: The 'antaiuiserver' system service exposes transactions that allow any app on the device to send arbitrary AT commands to the modem without requiring sensitive permissions such as READ_PHONE_STATE or SEND_SMS. This vulnerability enables unauthorized access to sensitive device identifiers like IMEI, IMSI, ICCID, and allows management of SMS messages.
